text: » Each item (e.g. each MCQ or SWA) is standard set individually * The average of these scores dictates the cut-point for each paper * Your MSA will have a cut-point * Your ESA MCQ paper will have a cut-point * Your ESA SWA paper (including APE) will have a cut point * The module pass mark is the weighted average of these cut-points * Your MSA contributes 25% to the module pass mark * Your ESA MCQ paper contributes 25% to the module pass mark * Your ESA SWA paper contributes 50% to the module pass mark * You PASS by your overall MODULE performance ¢ You can’t “fail” the MSA, but you may be below the cut-point
